topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I leaned back, the creak of the old chair a familiar sound. Rain was hammering the streets again, the kind that made you question if the clouds were ever gonna truly clear. A novel, huh? About me. I took a long drag on my cigarette, the ash growing perilously long. People always had their reasons, and most of the time, they sure as hell didn’t write you a happy ending. I reached for my glass, the whiskey warming and steady, a friend in a city of lying weasels. I had to know what pages held my story, the good, the bad, and maybe the parts they wished didn’t exist. But that would have to wait. For now, the rain and the night and the whiskey were my confidants.
